explain_task.question: Using the revised model’s LP-relaxation diagnostics and the final MIP solution, explain why the objective drops from 6160.0 to 5060.0 even though the production quantities `y_0` and `y_1` stay the same as in the original solution. You must trace the exact code additions `z[j]`, `shared_ab_wrapper`, the constraint `y[j] <= M * z[j]`, and the three wrapper-trigger constraints back to the business brief and to the exact CSV fields `SetupCost_A`, `SetupCost_B`, `BrandAB_SharedWrapper_Fee`, and `Monthly Limit (kg)`; also state the numeric value of `M`. Then identify which LP-relaxation constraints are binding with nonzero duals for this logic, interpret the shadow prices/business meaning of those marginal values, and explain why using those LP duals to linearly extrapolate the integer model’s profit impact is invalid here.
